changelog: Counter-hack reworked: the word-typing game is gone, replaced by two real mini-games drawn at random: Firewall (destroy incoming packets) and Port Sequence (memory game). Fully configurable in game.
New admin command /conf_acn_security_duel to try the counter-hack mini-game instantly; the rival can now strike right from the start of a mission.
New node-based mission editor (Scenarios tab): create your own legal or illegal contracts and rewrite the texts and guide commands of the built-in ones.
The contract board now refreshes as soon as a mission ends.
Terminal: a loading bar with the remaining time is shown while a slow machine is answering.
Terminal response delay reworked: the laptop is very slow (about 15-20 s), the tower about 5 s, and upgrades speed it up (tower near instant, laptop never below 5 s).
New counter-hack duel during illegal missions: a rival hacker hits back and you must out-type them, or you lose the mission.
Illegal contracts now show up in the Darknet app on illegal devices (and no longer in the mail board).
The in-game configuration has no limits anymore (any value, including 0 or huge numbers), with a global search and a cleaner layout.
Legal and illegal editions of the laptop and the tower, each sold by its own vendor (upgrades are sold by both).
Legal devices run white-hat contracts only; illegal devices add black-hat, darknet, crypto wallet, hacker chat, market and intrusions.
Tower desktop rebuilt in a Windows 11 style (search, start menu, notifications, tray, right-click menu); laptop keeps its own Linux look.
Terminal answers are grouped in readable blocks, and an un-upgraded tower now takes time to answer (CPU and SSD shorten it).
Fixed desktop PCs disappearing after a resource restart (automatic client sync on startup).
Fixed Tier 1 mission level requirements: whois command is now available from level 1 and active mission commands bypass level locks.
Terminal overhaul: toolbar, right-click menu, persistent history with Ctrl+R search, ghost suggestions, column completion, aliases, echo, copy and timestamp commands.
Fixed mouse text selection in the terminal (drag, double-click word, triple-click line).
You can now select text and use Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V in the terminal and in every window.
Tutorial: closing the terminal during the command part now restarts that part cleanly with its instructions.
Windows-style desktop on the PC tower (centered taskbar, start menu grid, Windows lock screen) and a hacker Linux look on the laptop (top panel, terminal boot).
New 'Match device' wallpaper, used by default.
Fixed a game crash when placing the shop NPC with the placement tool.
Co-op: invite up to 3 players on a contract, each with their own part of the job and a shared payout.
Player vs player intrusions on placed PCs, with live owner alerts, firewall, decoy files and an intrusion log.
Anonymous hacker forum, player market with escrow, and contracts posted by players.
Field missions (USB key on a server rack, capture box near a building, kiosk repair), with points placed in game.
City effects: temporary camera access, neighbourhood blackout and traffic light disruption, plus exports for other scripts.
CTF events launched by staff or scheduled weekly, with a live leaderboard and rewards, and 3 new terminal mini-games.
Darknet, crypto wallet, darknet software, desktop hardware components and police Cyber-crime tools (1.1.0).
Laptop and placeable desktop PC running ACN OS, procedural missions, tutorial, shop and full in-game configuration (1.0.0).
